"Lost in Love" is a song recorded by the British/Australian soft rock duo Air Supply.
The song was written by group member Graham Russell.
The original version of the song appeared on the Life Support album in 1979 and was released as a single in Australia, reaching number 13 on the Kent Music Report.
Air Supply are a British-Australian soft rock duo formed in Melbourne in 1975.
They have released 17 studio albums, 13 compilation albums, 4 live albums and 27 singles.
